mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 2.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during periods with FEDFUNDS < 2.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000 jobs per month, the labor market's strength predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.5% MoM signals supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of months with INDPRO MoM growth > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in RSAFS by more than 5% YoY indicates weakening consumer demand, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4% and CPIAUCSL growth is above 2% YoY, the combination predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to tightening financial conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 55% of instances when both trigger conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected spike in UNRATE by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns following the trigger are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in HOUST by more than 10% YoY indicates robust housing demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during mid-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism in mid-cycle expansions remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.
